landing.heroSubtitle: Present without preparing slides: talk about your topic and Live Presentation builds the deck in real time, ready to show full screen.
landing.stepsSubtitle: Three steps and you are presenting.

s1.title: Set topic and audience
s1.text: Tell the studio what you will talk about and for whom: tone and design adapt.

s2.title: Speak
s2.text: Speak naturally. Live transcription turns your voice into text turn by turn.

s3.title: Present full screen
s3.text: Slides appear on their own on stage. Move through them with arrow keys or show them full screen.

landing.featuresSubtitle: What already works today in the live studio.

f1.title: Real-time transcription
f1.text: Your voice becomes text instantly, with partial captions as you speak.

f2.title: 21 automatic layouts
f2.text: The system picks the ideal design for each idea: titles, bullets, quotes, comparisons and more.

f3.title: Adaptive palettes
f3.text: Each presentation takes colors matching your topic, in light and dark mode.

f4.title: Off-topic filter
f4.text: Off-topic remarks never pollute your slides: they are filtered out without interrupting.

f5.title: Progressive images
f5.text: Slides appear first with text, then gain a generated image without blocking.

f6.title: All in your browser
f6.text: Microphone, stage and navigation live on the web: nothing to install, just speak.

landing.ctaTitle: Try it by speaking, not reading
landing.ctaText: Enter the studio, set your topic and start talking. Slides appear on their own.
landing.contactText: Want to use Live Presentation in your classes, talks or team? Write to us and we will tell you how to start.

t1.transcript: Today we talk about habits that sustain the team's energy…
t1.title: Team energy
t1.text: Three simple habits keep the pace without burning anyone out.

t2.transcript: First: real breaks, no screens, every ninety minutes…
t2.title: Real breaks
t2.text: Resting without screens restores focus for the next block.

t3.transcript: And to close: one clear idea per slide, nothing more…
t3.title: One idea per slide
t3.text: If everything matters, nothing is remembered. One idea, one slide.
